moments.text: Upright phone video at night, lower part blurred for privacy: a small light sits between two thin overhead wires above a blurred bright area.
The camera zooms in fast in several steps; the blurred lower part drops out of view, leaving the light and the wires.
Zoomed in: a bright white point with a soft glow sits just above the lower of two wires, keeping its place as the view slowly tilts.
Step frame by frame: the glowing core flickers between pink, cyan, green, white and blue. It holds the same spot between the wires to the end.
